evidence_origin: Completed checks collected from output/. Collection rechecks generator source/configuration and artifact hashes, not the semantic tests themselves.
scope: Fresh exact regeneration and allocation replay for all 31 points; 256 native strict-ledger basis inputs per query; every valid row with two system inputs for each core and its Qualtran decomposition; three complete QASM parser/operation checks. No full-state simulation of a complete query, new FCIDUMP derivation, global-optimality proof, or new full upstream grader run.

reference.scope: Every stored Pauli, sign, alias mass and largest-remainder weight; FCIDUMP-to-Pauli derivation is a separate upstream check.

primitives.scope: For each transposition, both Kraus branches equal the signed fermionic swap times 1/sqrt(2), on every basis column. This establishes the coherent primitive channel, not the full query.

instrument.scope: Small channel test of actual QueryInstrument lowering, including fresh outcome XOR, measurement and conditional CZ. Whole 40-qubit queries are not densely simulated.

native.scope: Both measurement outcomes algebraically on each tested basis input; input sampling does not prove all coherent input states.
